item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J01905","case1_error":"Multiplies the already combined $150 earnings by three again, double-counting the workers.","case2_error":"No clear error: “three times more than” ambiguously permits either three times or four times as many trees.","reason":"Case 1 repeats an already included factor; case 2 depends on ambiguous wording.","judgment":"uncertain"},{"pair_id":"J01906","case1_error":"Writes correct group formulas, then introduces unsupported numbers and an extra summand, producing 112 instead of 40.","case2_error":"Equates dog and cat owners to all citizens, ignoring the stated 60% pet ownership rate.","reason":"Case 1 introduces unsupported numerical results after correct formulas; case 2 explicitly writes an erroneous population equation, regardless of what “half” modifies.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01907","case1_error":"Evaluates the correctly written sum 30 + 35 + 46 as 101 instead of 111.","case2_error":"Equates future age to the five-year interval, then unjustifiably identifies the century’s 100 years as Gideon’s age.","reason":"Case 1 is numerical evaluation of a correct expression; case 2 misrepresents the age relation and conflates unrelated quantities.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01908","case1_error":"Adds books already within the 99-book collection to the initial total and omits those books from donations.","case2_error":"Multiplies Saturday’s earnings by five along with weekday earnings, counting five Saturdays per week.","reason":"Case 1 misclassifies existing books and donations; case 2 applies a repetition factor to earnings that occur only once weekly.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01909","case1_error":"Provides unsupported numerical answers ending in 5660 after correct formulas; the requested total is 3240 minutes.","case2_error":"Uses 100 − 30 + 10 for new women instead of adding 10 to the original 30 women.","reason":"Case 1 gives unsupported numbers without a shown faulty calculation;
